title: Does lifting make women bulky? 🏋️‍♀️
caption:
Women gain muscle and strength well, about the same as men relative to their size, but with far less testosterone, big size takes years. Lifting builds shape, strength and stronger bones. Tag someone who needs to hear this 👇

Gym Myths Busted #2
first_comment: Ladies, what stopped you from lifting before? 👇
sources: Roberts BM, Nuckols G, Krieger JW. Sex differences in resistance training: a systematic review and meta-analysis. J Strength Cond Res 2020;34:1448-1460
Handelsman DJ, Hirschberg AL, Bermon S. Circulating testosterone as the hormonal basis of sex differences in athletic performance. Endocr Rev 2018;39:803-829

Watson SL et al. High-intensity resistance and impact training improves bone mineral density and physical function in postmenopausal women with osteopenia and osteoporosis: the LIFTMOR randomized controlled trial. J Bone Miner Res 2018;33:211-220
